---
name: Correction
about: Report a factual error in the paper or its supporting documents
title: "[correction] "
labels: correction
assignees: ""
---

## Where is the error?

File (`paper.html` / `docs/rack-heat-note.md` / `README.md`) and the section or
sentence it appears in.

## What is wrong?

What the paper says now, and what it should say instead.

## Source

Link or citation supporting the corrected claim (arXiv, vendor datasheet,
published spec, measurement). If this is your own measurement, describe the
setup briefly.

## Impact

Does this change any stated number (e.g. the 100 kW / 18.75 kW envelope) or
only the prose around it?
